items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kimery: Billy Taylor, Shirley Horn, Elvin Jones, wow. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, that's not you? ... [INTERVIEWER] Well, it sets the record straight.
